title: Buying his first horn on layaway and seeing Louis Jordan
summary: He saved ten dollars for a pawn-shop trumpet and later recalls seeing Louis Jordan on a jukebox film near Betty's Inn.

bands.name: Louis Jordan and His Tympany Five
